quality.rationale: MVP functionality is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Direct canvas editing, layer D&D, font dropdown, and named templates are included. Cross-browser coverage remains future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend or paid service dependency.

delivery.rationale: Implementation, docs, tests, build, Pages workflow, release checklist, runtime evidence, and a passing remote Pages deployment are complete. Broader real-device checks remain future work.

satisfaction.rationale: Primary requested workflow passed: CSV/HTML import, image import, inspector edits, direct canvas move/resize/rotate, layer ordering, font dropdown, named template save/load/delete, effects controls, and PNG/JPEG/WebP export path. Broader template variety remains future work.

runtimeGate.requirement: Chrome or headless browser confirms nonblank render, primary elements, and primary operations.
